question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"still"** means continuing to be in the same state or condition without change.
 
• In the context of the passage, **"still" **conveys that despite knowing something well, the feeling of unsafety persisted.
 
• The other options: "can" and "sometime" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** "For all that I knew this perfectly well, I still__ felt as if it were not safe to let the coach-office be out of my sight ..."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Can (सकना)**: indicates ability or possibility.
 
• **Sometime (कभी-कभी)**: refers to an unspecified point in time.
